piperMarkdown.enhanced.configPath.markdo: Restart is required after changes. The global configuration directory path. Leave it empty to use `$HOME/.crossnote` for Windows or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/.crossnote` or `$HOME/.local/state/crossnote` as the config path.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.markdownParser.de: Markdown parser/renderer to use. 'markdown-it' (default) is the built-in renderer. 'pandoc' uses Pandoc (requires Pandoc installed; not available in VS Code web). 'markdown_yo' uses a high-performance WASM renderer (or native binary when markdownYoBinaryPath is set; experimental).
piperMarkdown.enhanced.markdownParser.en: Render via Pandoc. Requires Pandoc to be installed. Not available in VS Code web.
High-performance renderer (experimental). Uses WASM by default, or a native binary when markdownYoBinaryPath is set. markdown-it is still used for token-based operations.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.breakOnSingleNewL: In Markdown, a single newline character doesn't cause a line break in the generated HTML. In GitHub Flavored Markdown, that is not true. Enable this config option to insert line breaks in rendered HTML for single newlines in Markdown source.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.scrollSync.descri: Automatic scroll sync. This is now partially supported.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.liveUpdate.descri: Re-render the preview as the contents of the source changes, without requiring the source buffer to be saved. If disabled, the preview is re-rendered only when the buffer is saved to disk.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.liveUpdateDebounc: Debounce time in milliseconds for live updates. Higher values reduce CPU usage but may feel less responsive. Lower values provide more immediate feedback but may impact performance.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.previewMode.markd:
- **Single Preview**: Only one preview will be shown for all editors.
- **Multiple Previews**: Multiple previews will be shown. Each editor has its own preview.
- **Previews Only**: No editor will be shown. Only previews will be shown. You can use the in-preview editor to edit the markdown.

Restart is required after changes.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.automaticallyShow: Automatically show preview of markdown being edited.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.disableAutoPrevie: A list of URI schemes (e.g., `vscode-notebook-cell`) to exclude from the `automaticallyShowPreviewOfMarkdownBeingEdited` feature. Files matching these schemes won't trigger the automatic preview.

A list of file name patterns (e.g., `*.note.md`) to exclude from the `automaticallyShowPreviewOfMarkdownBeingEdited` feature. Files whose names match any of these patterns won't trigger the automatic preview. Supports `*` as a wildcard. Matching is performed against the file's basename (not full path) and is case-insensitive.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.previewColorSchem: Follow system color scheme. If set to true, then the theme of markdown preview will automatically switch between light and dark when your system switch between light and dark. For example, if you set the current preview theme to `github-light.css`, then when your system is dark, the preview theme will be switched to `github-dark.css` automatically. If set to false, then the theme of markdown preview will not be changed automatically.

Use the same theme as the editor (light or dark). If set to true, then the theme of markdown preview will automatically switch between light and dark when you switch between vscode light and dark theme. For example, if you set the current preview theme to `github-light.css`, then when you switch to vscode dark theme, the preview theme will be switched to `github-dark.css` automatically. If set to false, then the theme of markdown preview will not be changed automatically.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableTypographer: Enable smartypants and other sweet transforms.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.mathRenderingOpti: Choose the Math expression rendering method here. You can also disable math rendering if you want by choosing 'None'.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.mathInlineDelimit: Use customized Math expression inline delimiters.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.mathBlockDelimite: Use customized Math expression block delimiters.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.mathRenderingOnli: Choose the Math expression rendering method option for GFM markdown export (Save as Markdown).
MathJax script source. Leave it empty to use the default CDN (MathJax v4).
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableWikiLinkSyn: Enable Wiki Link syntax support. More information can be found at https://help.github.com/articles/adding-links-to-wikis/
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableLinkify.des: Enable or disable conversion of URL-like text to links in the markdown preview.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.useGitHubStylePip: If checked, we use GitHub style piped wiki links, i.e. [[linkText|wikiLink]]. Otherwise, we use [[wikiLink|linkText]] as the original Wikipedia style.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableEmojiSyntax: Enable emoji & font-awesome plugin. This only works for markdown-it parser, but not pandoc parser.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableExtendedTab: Enable extended table syntax to support merging table cells.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableCriticMarku: Enable CriticMarkup syntax. Only works with markdown-it parser. Please check http://criticmarkup.com/users-guide.php for more information.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableTagSyntax.d: Enable Obsidian-style #tag syntax. Renders `#tag-name` (and nested `#parent/child`) as clickable pill-shaped anchors. Click a tag to open VS Code's "Search in Files" pre-filled with the tag.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.maxNoteFileSize.m: Maximum size (in bytes) of a Markdown file that crossnote will load into the in-memory note index. Files larger than the cap are skipped during workspace refresh — they won't appear in autocomplete, backlinks, or the tag panel, but you can still open them via wikilink click. Prevents pathological cases where a checked-in log/data dump with a `.md` extension would otherwise pin its full content (plus a parsed token tree) in memory. Set to `0` to disable the cap.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.wikiLinkTargetFil: The file extension for the link in wikilink if the link does not have an extension.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.wikiLinkResolutio:
How bare-filename wiki links (e.g. `[[Note]]`) are resolved to a file path.

- `relative` — resolve relative to the current note's directory (default).
- `shortest` — search all notes by filename, preferring the shortest unique path (with same-directory tiebreaking). Obsidian-style.
- `absolute` — resolve from the notebook/workspace root.

Links starting with `/` always resolve from the notebook root regardless of this setting.
Resolve relative to the current note's directory.
Search all notes by filename, preferring the shortest unique path.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.wikiLinkTargetFil: The case for the file name in wikilink. If the value is `none`, then the file name will not be changed. Otherwise, the file name will be transformed to the specified case. You can read https://www.npmjs.com/package/case-anything for more details.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.frontMatterRender: Render front matter as a table with one column per key
Render front matter as a table with one key and value per row
Render front matter as a code block
piperMarkdown.enhanced.mermaidTheme.desc: Mermaid theme, you can choose one from ["mermaid.css", "mermaid.dark.css", "mermaid.forest.css"]
piperMarkdown.enhanced.codeBlockTheme.de: Code block theme. If `auto.css` is chosen, then the code block theme that best matches the current preview theme will be picked.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.imageFolderPath.d: When using Image Helper to copy images, by default images will be copied to root image folder path '/assets'
piperMarkdown.enhanced.imageUploader.des: You can choose different image uploader to upload image
piperMarkdown.enhanced.printBackground.d: Whether to print background for file export or not. If set to `false`, then `github-light` preview theme will be used. You can also set `print_background` in front-matter for individual files.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.chromePath.descri: Chrome executable path, which is used for Puppeteer export. Leaving it empty means the path will be found automatically.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.imageMagickPath.d: ImageMagick command line path. Should be either `magick` or `convert`. Leaving it empty means the path will be found automatically.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.markdownYoBinaryP: Path to the markdown_yo native binary. When set and markdownParser is 'markdown_yo', crossnote will use this binary (via stdin/stdout) instead of the bundled WASM module. The native binary is faster for files under ~300 KB; WASM is faster for very large files. Supports $HOME and ~ variable substitution. Leave empty to use WASM (default).
piperMarkdown.enhanced.pandocMarkdownFla: The pandoc markdown flavor you want
piperMarkdown.enhanced.pandocArguments.d: Args passed to pandoc command e.g. ["--smart", "--filter=/bin/exe"] Please use long argument names.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.latexEngine.descr: Default latex engine for Pandoc export and latex code chunk.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableScriptExecu:
Enables executing code chunks and importing javascript files.
⚠️ Please use this feature with caution because it may put your security at risk! Your machine can get hacked if someone makes you open a markdown with malicious code while script execution is enabled. Piper requires explicit user-level permission and a trusted workspace; workspace settings and .crossnote configuration cannot enable execution.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enablePreviewScri:
Enables user-provided preview scripts: `<script src>` tags in `.crossnote/head.html` and `@import "*.js"` file imports. Only files inside the workspace can be loaded — inline scripts and remote URLs are never executed.
⚠️ Please use this feature with caution: scripts run inside the preview webview, so a malicious repository could abuse whatever the preview has access to. This setting can only be changed in user settings and is ignored in untrusted workspaces.
Enables transform audio video link to to html5 embed audio video tags.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.HTML5EmbedIsAllow: When true embed media with http:// schema in URLs. When false ignore and don't embed them.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.HTML5EmbedAudioAt: HTML attributes to pass to audio tags.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.HTML5EmbedVideoAt: HTML attributes to pass to video tags.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.puppeteerWaitForT: Puppeteer waits for a certain timeout in milliseconds before the document export.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.plantumlServer.de: Render using PlantUML server instead of binary. Leave it empty to use the builtin plantuml.jar binary (`java` is required in system path). Eg: "http://localhost:8080/svg/"
piperMarkdown.enhanced.hideDefaultVSCode: Hide the default VSCode markdown preview extension buttons. Restarting the editor is required to make this config take effect.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.plantumlJarPath.d: Absolute path to the plantuml.jar file (`java` is required in system path). You can download it from https://plantuml.com/download.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.krokiServer.descr: The URL of the Kroki server to use.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.webSequenceDiagra: The URL of the WebSequenceDiagrams server to use for rendering wsd code blocks.
API key for WebSequenceDiagrams. Required for wider diagram sizes.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.d2Path.descriptio: Path to the D2 executable. Defaults to `d2` (i.e. found on PATH). Not supported in the web extension.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.d2Layout.descript: Default D2 layout engine for rendering d2 diagrams.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.d2Theme.descripti: Default D2 theme for rendering d2 diagrams.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.d2Sketch.descript: Render D2 diagrams in sketch (hand-drawn) style.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.markdownFileExten: Markdown file extensions. This is used to determine whether to show the preview button in the markdown file context menu.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enablePreviewZenM: Enable this option will hide unnecessary UI elements in preview unless your mouse is over it.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.useVSCodeThemeFor: When enabled, the context menu in preview inherits VS Code's theme colors and font instead of the default styling.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enablePreviewCont: Show the extension's custom right-click menu in the preview. Disable it to fall back to the browser's native context menu, with its usual Copy/Paste entries.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.enableImageLightb: Click an image in the preview to view it in a full-screen lightbox overlay. Press Escape or click the backdrop to close.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.aiTranslationProv: AI provider id for the Translate feature, e.g. "openai", "anthropic", "minimax-cn", "deepseek". See @earendil-works/pi-ai provider list.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.aiTranslationMode: Model id for AI translation, e.g. "gpt-4o-mini". Must be a valid model for the chosen provider.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.aiTranslationAuto: When the preview is in translation mode, automatically re-translate changed blocks after you stop typing for 3 seconds. Disabled by default to avoid unattended API usage.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.setAiTranslationA: Piper Markdown: Set AI Translation API Key
piperMarkdown.enhanced.exportColorScheme: How HTML and browser exports pick their color scheme: render in the configured `previewTheme` and `codeBlockTheme` on every machine (`theme`), or follow the reader's system color scheme by embedding light/dark theme pairs (`auto`). Paper exports (Chrome PDF, Prince) are not affected. Can be overridden per file with front matter `html: { export_color_scheme: auto }`.
Export in the configured preview theme and code block theme. The export looks the same on every machine, even for readers whose system is set to dark mode.
Follow the reader's system color scheme: the export embeds both the light and dark variants of the configured themes, and the page switches when the reader's OS switches (`prefers-color-scheme`).
piperMarkdown.enhanced.crossnoteServePor: Port used by the crossnote server started via the Start crossnote Server command. Auto-increments when busy.
piperMarkdown.enhanced.applyDefaultEdito: Piper Markdown: Apply Preview Mode as Default Editor
